about_the_game:
Add flair to your penguin with the Red Hat DLC! Whether you’re sliding, smashing, or splashing, this iconic Red Hat ensures you stand out in every icy brawl. Elevate your penguin’s style and let the battlefield know who’s the most fashionable waddler on the ice!

Purchasing and installing this DLC allows you to wear the hat in game during matchs and in the main menu.
